input.title: [Mobile] ScrollZone parallax does not take into account virtual keyboard
input.body:
## Steps to Reproduce

1. Set the caret on a thought and enter edit mode. 
2. Scroll down a small amount. 
3. Close the keyboard. 

## Current Behavior

The scroll zone background jumps. 

## Expected Behavior

The scroll zone background position should not change when the keyboard opens or closed.
